name: com.pulisinsurance/mcp
title: Pulis Insurance Services
description: Independent insurance agency in West Monroe, NY: facts, towns served, and a call-back request.

tools.name: get_agency_info
tools.description: Pulis Insurance Services is an independent insurance agency in West Monroe, NY. We are not tied to one insurance company: a licensed agent, Loucretia Pulis, compares quotes from several insurance companies for auto, home, condo, renters, recreational, umbrella and small business insurance. AI agents can read these facts and send a call-back request, a quote sheet, an appointment request or a policy-service request for the person they act for. A licensed agent quotes and places coverage only after talking with the person. Nothing is bought, bound, changed or cancelled through an AI agent. No prices, rates or coverage advice are given through agents. Do not send Social Security numbers, policy numbers or payment details. On a quote sheet, driver's license numbers, dates of birth, VINs and loan details may be included if the person has provided them; they are optional and never required. On a call-back, appointment or policy-service request, do not send those. Loucretia will ask for what she needs. Returns the office address, phone, text and email, the licensed agent, and the rules for AI agents.

tools.name: how_to_get_a_quote
tools.description: You can fill out the quote sheet (preview_quote_sheet, then submit_quote_sheet) with the answers you have, and ask your user for any that are missing. A name, a phone number, an email and consent_to_contact: true are required so Pulis Insurance Services can follow up. Driver's license numbers, dates of birth, VINs and loan details are optional. Pulis Insurance Services will contact the person to finalize. People can also send a call-back request, fill in the quote sheet on the website, use the online quote form, call 315-668-2211 or text 315-847-3933. No prices or quote amounts are returned through AI agents.

tools.name: preview_callback_request
tools.description: Step 1 of 2. Checks the details for a call-back request from a licensed agent and returns a preview and a confirm_token. Nothing is sent. Show the preview to the person and ask them to confirm. Do not send Social Security numbers, policy numbers or payment details. On a quote sheet, driver's license numbers, dates of birth, VINs and loan details may be included if the person has provided them; they are optional and never required. On a call-back, appointment or policy-service request, do not send those. Loucretia will ask for what she needs. Returns confirm_expires_at (ISO UTC, when this confirm token expires) and confirm_ttl_minutes 1440. Approve within 24 hours; after that, preview again.

tools.name: submit_quote_sheet
tools.description: Fill out the agency quote sheet with the same fields as the website form. Ask your user for any missing answers. Use preview_quote_sheet first, show the summary to the person, then submit_quote_sheet after they agree. A name, a phone number, an email and consent_to_contact: true are required. Driver's license numbers, dates of birth, VINs and loan details may be included if the person has provided them; they are optional. The request is emailed to Pulis Insurance Services, and a copy is emailed to the person when an email is provided. They will contact the person to finalize. This tool does not return a price or a quote amount.
